title: AIR CONDITIONED: Savoy Students To Be Cool Cats When Classes Take Up This Fall
text:
The Denison Herald
SUNDAY FEATURES
SUNDAY MORNING, AUGUST 28, 1966

STAINLESS STEEL KITCHEN — The stainless steel serving line in the Savoy school cafeteria is backed up by an assortment of pots, steamers, deep fryers and other food preparation equipment, most of it in stainless steel also. The cafeteria seating along with a stage at one end.

SAVOY SCHOOL BOARD — [Photo caption]: Robert F. Hodges[?], 5th from the left, is the new Savoy superintendent with five of the seven members of the Savoy School Board. Later, the new school has its own temperature control. The building has a 250,000 BTU heating system and costs $1[?] [illegible].

AIR CONDITIONED:
Savoy Students To Be Cool Cats When Classes Take Up This Fall

By JOHN CLIFF

SAVOY — It is only proper that at this time Lone Star Gas and Power Light Co. should sponsor a multi-million dollar Valley Forge article, with a new air-conditioned school in the carefully controlled school atmosphere.

This new Savoy school is unlike any school in the district. It is truly the school of the second millennium. It is unique in many respects. It is truly a self-contained, climate-controlled school at the multi-million dollar Valley Forge, it is used by the community as well, not only for academic studies, over 8 double-covered school on that site for forty or more years.

The new building has an office, a three classroom with a principal's office and a catalog secretary library office. There are two connected rooms with their administrative facilities in the library. There is a book room for extra textbooks and there is another similar room for the school's department. There are three of the school's departments here and there and they built these years ago with the maximum size room. One room was added as it was told for the present building.

COLORFUL LIBRARY — A well-lighted library in the new Savoy school. A comfortable furniture at attractive prices. A shelving stocks can be seen in the background; and a rack for periodicals are at the right. Library seats approximately [illegible] students.
